summary: Pickets jeer officials who cross their line and cheer those who stay away.
realLife: Oakland city workers jeered department heads who crossed their line and cheered those who stayed away; a new fire chief was heavily booed.
sources: East Bay Express, Oakland council and picket line: https://eastbayexpress.com/?p=12348
inGame: the public-action engine (protest record: what it is over, who is in it, how many came: few, group or crowd) with officials at its edge; officials whose record shows they crossed or stayed away

turns.summary: The official walks through the noise with their head down.
turns.writesBack: workers' view of the official sours

turns.summary: The official decides not to cross and goes home.
The official stops and talks briefly with the line.
turns.writesBack: short exchange; a promise to meet
